role: Independent semantic Reviewer; not correction author; no owner disposition authority
work_class: bounded assessment of separately authored proposed correction

writes: own new OS temporary prefix ac-review-semantic-fixes-**
operations: optional read-only application check and scratch replay

oracle.basis: this Reviewer's prior CLOSED source-first C01-C20 population, fixed before original candidate exposure
affected_cases: C03 general result grounds and internal consistency
C08 applicability unknown, exclusion and permitted alternatives
oracle.expected_positive: When applicability is undecidable on admissible evidence and also needs an undeclared material relation, either indeterminate or out_of_frame is lawful with its named ground. Retain missing evidence/relation and the unresolved obligation in required coverage.
oracle.expected_negative: Do not require out_of_frame instead of indeterminate merely because the undeclared-relation ground coexists; do not map unknown applicability to falsified, exclude the unresolved obligation, or report it satisfied.
oracle.refinement_condition: A claimed scoped refinement needs a declared question, predicate, values and lawful owner/parent mapping. ACTIVATION's five named step refinements supply no exclusive applicability override.
oracle.conserved_cases: Retain other prior bounded case judgments where exact unchanged record content, order, source basis, signature, dispositions and grounding are verified. A role/session change alone is no invalidator.

subjects.allowed_delta: one predicate.exceptions[0] string, model identity, new interpretation-contract id/digest, new interpreter id/digest, and one appended provenance entry; all other records/order/source basis/signature/dispositions/grounding preserved

exposure.prior_original_models_and_closed_review: retained declared prior exposure; not an unexposed reconstruction trial
exposure.claims: proposal fidelity and bounded deterministic packaging controls only; no full-source proof, original-generation equivalence, semantic acceptance, Product/release or efficiency claim
